audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side read a blanket "Sylas" on all seven rows while content win[0..6] reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Malzahar/Skill and the packet levelChart agrees with the content layer. The page rendered two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: The whys under those rows already describe Malzahar's pattern working, so the full-layer side was the wrong layer. Content layer already matches the packet, so side is edited alone (win[N] before would equal after).
audit.corrected: phases side set to Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Malzahar/Skill, with the whys rewritten to state why each stage is even or Malzahar's.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Lost Chapter shove engine, level 6 Nether Grasp, Liandry's, late scaling. Sylas's own spike is Hijack at 80/55/30 and Kingslayer rank-ups shortening his sustain cycle from 12s to 6s.
audit.corrected: Recorded in cooldowns and phase whys rather than duplicated into spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never named a single Sylas ability in mechanical terms and invented "Iron Boundary" for Malzahar's passive (real name: Void Shift). breakdown.cooldowns carried no cooldown number at all.
audit.why: Kit authority: Sylas E is Abscond with the Abduct recast, 13/12/11/10/9s, 400 range, projectile recast; W Kingslayer heals, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s; Q Chain Lash 10/9/8/7/6s, 775 range, slow; P Petricite Burst grants attack speed after each cast. Malzahar Q is 6s flat with a silence; R suppresses at 140/110/80.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Abscond 13s->9s, Kingslayer 12s, Hijack 80s; the silence advice is keyed to Abscond's landing rather than to Chain Lash.

audit.why: Field exists to hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Abscond/Abduct 13s at rank 1 to 9s at rank 5, Kingslayer 12s early, Hijack 80s at rank 1.

audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Kingslayer sustains him through Malzahar's chip. report[8] already says "Add anti-heal early into his sustain", so the gap is already covered on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name "Iron Boundary" for Malzahar's passive; tradeGood described poking "his shield off" when Sylas has no shield in his kit.
audit.why: Kit lists no shield on Sylas; Malzahar's passive is Void Shift, which the content layer already names correctly.

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: E a caster minion and farm — Chain Lash is his only level-1 poke at 10s, so neither of you can commit. Even start.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: Q online: silence Abscond as he lands, not Chain Lash you can walk out of. Still even, both punish a step.

edits.before: W voidlings turn your shove permanent — the wave hits his tower while you ward, roam-shadow, or just exist safely.
edits.after: Voidlings make your shove permanent, but Abduct at 11s can pull you off it — even while he holds that chain.

edits.before: Lost Chapter and the machine is complete: E-hops fund themselves, the wave is always crashing, and his tower is always bleeding.
edits.after: Lost Chapter funds the E-hops and the wave always crashes, but Kingslayer heals your chip back — still a skill fight.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Even late: one suppression wins a fight, but Hijack at 30s hands him a real ultimate to flank you with. Shield up.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your spell shield (Iron Boundary) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct is 13s at rank 1 and 9s at rank 5 — that gap is when you step up. - Kingslayer is 12s early, so his sustain is simply gone between casts. - Hijack is 80s at rank 1: once he spends it, Void Shift and your R own the next minute.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Poke with E and let it tick — Kingslayer is 12s early, so a second trade inside that window finds him with no sustain and no dash out.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Extended brawls where Kingslayer keeps healing — Petricite Burst gives him attack speed after every cast and he out-autos you flat.

edits.before: Good trade: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets. Bad trade: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Good trade: poke with E and let it tick — Kingslayer is 12s early, so a second trade inside that window finds him with no sustain and no dash out. Bad trade: extended brawls where Kingslayer keeps healing and Petricite Burst's attack speed lets him out-auto you flat while Abduct holds you in place.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Abducting you off the wave, healing it back with Kingslayer, and stealing an ultimate worth more than yours.

edits.before: Carry by subtraction — every fight starts 4v5 when your R lands; your job is the wave control that makes the fight happen on your timer.
edits.after: Carry by subtraction — Nether Grasp on Sylas mid-dive is a 4v5, and he cannot cast Hijack while suppressed. Fight on your crash timer.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Voidlings shove for free — every wave he must answer is a roam he cannot take.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Abscond is his entry and Abduct is the recast pull; silence him mid-chain with Q and the second half never fires. Chain Lash you can simply walk out of.

edits.before: Sylas spends Abscond / Abduct early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: When he Absconds in, Nether Grasp suppresses him mid-dive and holds him for your jungler.

edits.before: That’s Sylas’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Q is 6s; spend it on Chain Lash and Abscond lands free six seconds later.

edits.before: Your Q is the only interrupt you own — silencing poke instead of his engage spell is how Malzahars get dove.
edits.after: At 6 he holds Hijack for a stolen ultimate — shoving blind with no vision is how that arrives on top of you.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: With Void Shift down and R spent you have no answer to Abduct — he pulls himself to you and Kingslayer heals through your chip.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns every crash into a map play. Cleanse answers a hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
